shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -B1 -A6 "date-components\|date-utils" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__ node_modules/@gravity-ui

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tail -8; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components peerDependencies dependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@2 version peerDependencies 2>/dev/null | tail -12
for v in 3.4.2 4.0.0 4.1.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json; done

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -8; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && ls dist dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n -i -A25 "required setup\|setup\|Calendar" README.md | head -120; ls dist/components/Calendar; cat dist/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -60; ls components; cat components/Calendar* 2>/dev/null | head -150
